_doc: Hand-authored verdicts for the 33 frame sites (never regenerated by build.py). Strength, route, bind, expiry and witness position are COMPUTED from the stored permits and the Atlas rows; nothing here asserts them. grade: 'narrative' = a sentence stating the operation (ceiling supports_A if the structural position is an Operations/Property/Equipment Description paragraph and the permit is unexpired); 'list' = a label, heading, table row or equipment list (supports_C). A term is a §3.1 term; ancillary units carry terms [] and say so.

quotes.quote: Open molding, mechanical, atomized, controlled spray-up application of non-vapor-suppressed resin and chopped fiberglass onto gelcoated molds.
quotes.note: P008 Chopper Booth #3; spray-up is the stated operation

quotes.quote: Manual lay-up of non-vapor-suppressed resin and fiberglass reinforcement to produce misc small parts and to manually bond steel mounts and fiberglass angles to bucket walls.
quotes.note: P003 Hand Lay-Up; manual lay-up is the stated operation

quotes.quote: Finish Gelcoat Booth. Open molding, atomized, controlled spray application of gelcoat to form a finished surface on the outside of fiberglass parts.
quotes.note: gelcoat spray booth: a finishing step, names no separate process (ancillary)

quotes.quote: Polyester gelcoat and FRP (fiberglass reinforced plastic parts) spray up booth.
quotes.note: K001-K005 table rows; owner ruling 2026-11-18b item 2 added composites_spray_up for this wording

quotes.quote: Thermoplastic roofing processing system. Includes compounding (minus coal tar pitch), Banbury mixer with drop mill, warm-up mill and calender.
quotes.note: equipment list under unit P921: calendering would be supports_C; capability row `calendering` only (tier A)

SITE-000264.note: lead only: not bound under the strict rule (printed 'Pkwy' vs Atlas 'Parkway')

quotes.quote: Latex - Synthetic Rubber Latex Manufacturing - polymerizers
quotes.note: P007 label naming the manufacture of synthetic rubber latex and its polymerizers: supports_C (the equipment list after 'polymerizers' is not quoted)

quotes.quote: Extrusion process including cooling, pelletizing, and screening.
quotes.note: P004; the unit text does not say compounding, so the _unspecified term; the permit's facility-description line 'ABS Compound Plant' is not a unit description and is not used

quotes.quote: K001, Hand Spray Paint Booth
quotes.note: miscellaneous metal parts paint booth: a finishing paint booth, ancillary

quotes.quote: Reverse roll coater with optional in-line rotogravure station and a 4.5 MM Btu/hour natural gas fired oven (direct-fired, 3 burners) - 80 line coater.
quotes.note: table row K001 in the 2020 FEPTIO, past its printed expiry 2025-04-01: supports_C; tier A; coating_applying has no §3.6 capability term

quotes.quote: Emissions Unit Group - Compounding: P002, P011, P012, P014
quotes.note: group heading: supports_C; tier A; no §3.6 capability mapping for an _unspecified term

quotes.quote: PTIO renewal for emissions unit P001 which is a polystyrene expander line for the expansion of polystyrene (EPS) pellets
quotes.note: the unit text says 'Polystyrene Expander Line, consisting of six expanders' with no foam word; only the permit description states the expansion of EPS pellets

quotes.quote: Continuous fiberglass laminating operation including, but not limited to: propeller mixer, saturating pans, squeeze rolls, electric ovens, conveyor, edge trim slitter and shear.
quotes.note: P001 Laminator; a statement of the operation

quotes.quote: Title V renewal for a paint and coatings manufacturing facility.
quotes.note: permit description (facility summary); the unit headings are 'Process N - area' with mixers and name no process

quotes.quote: Renewal PTIO for two miscellaneous metal parts coating lines at an electromagnetic coil manufacturing plant
quotes.note: permit description only: the word "coating" appears in the permit description, not in the unit description

quotes.quote: Epoxy dip station consisting of a vent hood over a dip pan and flash off rack, followed by an oven
quotes.note: R001/R002 table rows: a dip coating station, but the unit text never says coating, so it carries no §3.1 term

quotes.quote: Conveyor spray coating application with a 1.0 MMBtu/hr natural gas fired drying oven used for topcoat application on plastic, vinyl and wood products using HVLP spray gun
quotes.note: R001 Q-One Spray Booth: finishing spray booth, ancillary

quotes.quote: Woodworking operations (sawing, molding, sanding, routing, planning, shaping and floor sweeping)
quotes.note: wood, not a polymer process

SITE-001137.note: lead only: not bound under the strict rule (printed 'State Rte 21' vs Atlas 'State Route 21')

SITE-001510.note: the issuance block prints 'Sharon Twp., OH', the cover letter prints 'Sharon Center'; the strict bind compares the issuance block (the header parser read the PO box line as the municipality); either way the printed municipality is not the Atlas 'Sharon Center'

quotes.quote: BLENDING AND STORAGE OF POLYURETHANE COATINGS
quotes.note: P013 heading, permit past its printed expiry 2026-09-13: supports_C; tier B so a capability row

quotes.quote: FEPTIO renewal for blending vessels with powder dryers for the production of coatings and adhesives.
quotes.note: permit description only: not a unit description; the adhesive term is held

quotes.quote: Paper coating line that includes the following:
quotes.note: P004; permit past its printed expiry 2025-08-19: supports_C; tier A; no §3.6 capability term for coating_applying

quotes.quote: Spray booth #1 for lay-up of polyester resin mixes to make fiberglass reinforced plastic (FRP) parts
quotes.note: 'spray booth ... for lay-up': spray-up or hand lay-up is not stated, and no composites _unspecified term exists

SITE-002113.note: lead only: not bound under the strict rule (printed municipality 'Newbury Twp.' vs Atlas 'Newbury'); the term is also not stated

quotes.quote: Expandable polystyrene (EPS) foam line consisting of one 2,250 lbs/hr pre-expander, 42,000 cubic feet of aging capacity, one 6,000 lbs/hr ldro block molding machine
quotes.note: P001 equipment list: supports_C; tier B; foam_molding_bead has no §3.6 capability term

quotes.quote: Compounding and extruding
quotes.note: P006 label (heading and one-line description): supports_C; tier B so the capability row `compounding` (rollup of compounding_extrusion)
